title: The Yearbook of the band room
author: Petra Sandoval
blurb: Edmund Hartwell, the new kid at a school built over something old, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. Then the school's legendary ghost starts leaving notes addressed by name — in impossible ink — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must expose what the school board buried before prom.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
